transitions.evidence: parity contract (template v1) committed in its own commit before any comparison; sha256 in the ledger

scoring execution of the registered contract: every verdict ADMITTED; report committed whatever the verdict
scoring execution with a failing verdict; report committed
code fix + NEW contract version with fresh scoring seeds (no_retuning)
ledger flip + HISTORY entry + CI job for the component; new production results for it come from Rust and carry implementation/rust_commit/contract_id
static check: no active execution path imports or invokes the Python component

kernel_1.scope: abep_sim/intake_tpmc.py trace kernels K1-K5 via abep_core

rules.rule: no big bang: component-by-component (or a tightly coupled group named in one contract); a wave is a schedule, never an admission unit
exact input parity: byte-identical inputs, each with sha256
exact architecture/config/model-set/design-state-set hashes recorded by both runs; mismatch voids the comparison
deterministic seeds where applicable; development seed vs scoring seed; scoring seed spent once
tolerances preregistered before any comparison, per observable, by parity class
output-schema parity; byte-identical evidence where the contract says EXACT_BYTES (Python-compatible JSON/CSV float formatting)
conservation checks on Rust outputs: source mass/power balances exact; energy ledger residual < 2 %
domain/error parity: same failure class/status for invalid and out-of-domain inputs; documented divergences listed; no silent fallbacks
performance measured (same machine, same session), reported, never a decision criterion
provenance: Python reference commit + file sha256, Rust commit + source sha256, toolchain, Cargo.lock sha256, Julia/HallThruster where relevant, thread/BLAS env

never rewrite Python results, goldens, frozen data or fixtures to make Rust pass; every disagreement is investigated and classified (Rust defect / Python reference defect under its own governance / contract defect -> new version), never resolved by tolerance change
no_retuning: after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with fresh scoring seeds; no execution discarded
reference freeze: a contract binds the reference sha256; a changed reference refuses scoring (REFUSED_REFERENCE_CHANGED) until a new contract version
layer separation becomes crate dependency rules: physics crates never depend on abep-assess/abep-evidence (A9.22/A9.23; A9.24 items 3-5)
known physics inconsistencies are ported as is (A9.24 item 13 LaB6 paths: audit and owner decision first)
rule-1/2 frozen data and goldens are read byte-for-byte, never regenerated by the migration
kernel granularity allowed: a contract may admit a function subset of a module; the module retires only when all its functions are admitted
after admission, new production results for the component come from Rust

bid_boundary.rule: the bid uses the last completely verified pre-migration implementation (item-9 freeze B); migration is post-freeze; no partially migrated mixed implementation may silently become the bid source
bid_boundary.this_lane_merges: only after the bid-freeze SHA is recorded

proposed_guard.bid_source_manifest: docs/bid/bid_source_manifest_v1.json generated once at the freeze commit: commit, tag, sha256 of every file the bid package cites or executes (abep_sim/**, config/**, abep_sim/data/**, cited builders and outputs, abep_core sources + DEFAULT_BACKEND), migration state at freeze
proposed_guard.ci_check: bid_source_guard: fail if bid-package inputs differ from the manifest without an owner re-freeze record; fail if any bid-cited evidence carries implementation: rust provenance; fail if a rust-authoritative component's files are cited by the bid package other than at the manifest's frozen versions
proposed_guard.tag: bid tag immutable; bid package build verifies the manifest commit and refuses another tree
proposed_guard.result_provenance: every Rust-produced result carries implementation, rust_commit, contract_id

bid_boundary.implemented_by: the first migration implementation PR (not this record)

per-run execution provenance sidecar (Julia version, HallThruster commit, threads/BLAS, host, argv, input sha256)
